pairs.subject: conformance-checking
pairs.evidence: src/features/shared/registry/registryModel.ts:87 The onboarding 'Verify the loop' check passes only on Sink B invokes (`telemetry.invokes30d`, the registry usage/ lane) and never reads Sink A (`invokesDirect30d`, the events API), so an org correctly reporting through the `api` sink is held at 'active' forever, a false fail by the checker's own crudeness.

techniques.evidence: src/features/shared/registry/registryModel.ts:87 Only one of the two invoke sinks is read (registry-view.ts keeps both, invokesDirect30d for sink A), so a sink-A org can never reach 'done'. This is a false fail and the owner cannot fix it except by switching sinks.
src/features/shared/registry/registryModel.ts:144 Unable-to-check is shown in the step summary as its own state. It is not folded into pass or into 0 pointing.
src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:344 When the judged-pairs set is capped, that is disclosed and travels with the data. A partial matrix is never shown as complete.
src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:310 A sweep header row (presence) is not accepted as a map. Only a real mapSha counts as mapped, so visited-but-unmapped repos are not counted as clean.
